scope: Diary photo stories, photo questions, Android diary conversation, saved conversation review, Notes dictation, Flow speech-to-text, and Ask your past.
data: Synthetic writing, images, audio and pairing only. Native checks used a separate Android application ID. Installed Redkeep data and the old app/companion sources were not changed.

storage.version1Import: Accepted and normalized without resetting writing or sync state.
storage.tombstones: Preserve rich metadata; exclude deleted entries from retrieval and remove owned photo bytes through the durable file journal.
storage.otherDevices: Update other Redkeep devices before editing rich diary documents. Older clients reject payload version 2.

coverage: Schema 12 to 13 migration and writing, draft, sync and assignment preservation
Rich-entry round trips, text projections, source hashes, sync v1/v2 and secondary-device transactions
Immutable staged photo files, path/hash validation, missing originals, duplicate selection and picker recovery
Photos/Reflect/Review, empty-editor gating, offline questions, sequential AI questions, caption/model cache isolation and answer preservation
PCM terminal frames, microphone permissions/Settings, live talk interruptions and spoken-reply microphone ownership
Pairing-pinned speech recovery, signed TLS/WSS, malformed events, acknowledgement, expiry and protected cleanup
Flow speech-only readiness, reviewed text save with stable logical ID, composer preservation and no writing task
Notes editor/repository revision guards and retained transcript on conflicts
Conversation turn retention, secondary append deduplication, protected generated drafts, explicit retry and recovered-result revision validation
History budgets/date scopes/citations and exclusion of assistant turns, AI observations and question prompts
Interactive AI coordination, background/reset fences, interrupted cleanup and preference/pairing preservation
Current diary details/daily questions/search regressions; 320x480 layouts at 3x text and reduced motion
automated.followup: 26 focused repository, tombstone/sync and reset checks passed after the final metadata and late-cleanup fences.

android.buildWarnings: Existing Gradle native-access warning and flutter_tts Kotlin Gradle Plugin migration warning; no signing, SDK, ABI or inference-pin changes.

existingCompanion.modelOutputs: Synthetic test runtimes. This verifies protocol compatibility and state handling, not model accuracy or output quality.

notYetQualified: Real Whisper/VAD speech recognition accuracy and physical Android microphone interruption/silencing behaviour
Real companion writing and Qwen vision output quality for conversation, photo questions and history answers
Audible offline reply playback and device-specific voice removal/fallback on physical Android hardware
Physical iOS photo picker/library permission and saved-conversation review
intentionalBoundaries: iOS new recording and typed AI chat remain outside this migration
Flow persists only the reviewed ordinary text thought; no rewriting, summary or conversation follows
Photos/audio bytes are not journal-sync payloads
QVAC setup, its Android worker and other Notes/Flow AI tools are not migrated
